node.name: Over Easy Eggs
node.description: Learn how to cook the perfect over easy egg with tender whites and a rich, golden center—simple, satisfying, and totally delicious!

recipeInstructions.text: Crack the egg into a small bowl and set aside.
recipeInstructions.name: Crack the egg into a small bowl and set aside.

recipeInstructions.text: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Let heat up for 30 seconds. Once hot, add the butter to the center of the pan and heat until melted.
recipeInstructions.name: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Let heat up for 30 seconds. Once hot, add the butter to the center of the pan and heat until melted.

recipeInstructions.text: Add egg to the pan and let cook for 1 minute. Cover the pan and cook for 2 minutes. Once the egg white looks set/cooked, and the yolk is jiggly but not fully raw, use a plastic spatula to flip the egg. Cook for 1 more minute.
recipeInstructions.name: Add egg to the pan and let cook for 1 minute. Cover the pan and cook for 2 minutes. Once the egg white looks set/cooked, and the yolk is jiggly but not fully raw, use a plastic spatula to flip the egg. Cook for 1 more minute.

recipeInstructions.text: Use the spatula to lift the cooked egg out of the pan onto a plate. Sprinkle it with salt and pepper and serve.
